title: Larger Vertical Ridge Augmentation: A Retrospective Multicenter Comparative Analysis of Seven Surgical
authors: Techniques Pabst, Andreas, Abdulmonem Alshihri, Philipp Becker, Amely Hartmann, Diana Heimes, Eleni Kapogianni, Frank Kloss, Keyvan Sagheb, Markus Troeltzsch, Jochen Tunkel, and et al. 2025. "Larger Vertical Ridge Augmentation: A Retrospective Multicenter Comparative Analysis of Seven Surgical Techniques" Journal of Clinical Medicine 14, no. 12: 4284.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss NOVAMag (magnesium membrane, screw, SHIELD) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Vertical ARA techniques significantly differ regarding harvesting and insertion time, bone gain, graft resorption, donor site morbidity, dehiscence rates, removals, and costs. While ICGs achieved the highest bone volume, less inva sive techniques, such as CAD/CAM -based or resorbable scaffolds, reduced biological costs and complication risks. Technique selection should be individualized based on defects, patients, and reconstructive goals” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
